verdict.rationale: Asana's marketing docs claim each AI Teammate/agent has 'an identity, scoped permissions, an audit trail, and cost constraints' managed from the same console as human users, which speaks directly to least-privilege agent credentials, and separate docs describe standard token-based API auth. However there is no technical documentation on how to actually configure/scope these permissions (e.g. granular OAuth scopes, PAT restrictions) and no independent verification of this governance claim in practice. Missing for 10: concrete technical docs on scope configuration, independent/hands-on confirmation that agent permissions are truly least-privilege, and API-level (not just marketing) evidence.
